title: Payroll
desc: Dedicated payroll desk — overview, salary template, monthly run, staff accounts, loans, payslips, advances and reports.
routeNote: EMBEDDED-ONLY BY DESIGN (owner decision 2026-07-29). This field used to read '#/travels/payroll'. That address 404s and always has: payroll is not registered as a module in platform/core/config.js, and the Travels company manifest does not list it either, so the router has no door to open. The desk is reached through Accounts → Payroll on a company, and Master Accounts → Master Payroll at group level — the only ways anyone actually uses it. Registering the standalone route would add a second Payroll entry to the sidebar beside the Accounts tab that already exists; the owner chose not to. Nothing in the app reads this field (discovery only HEADs the file to see whether the folder still exists), so it is documentation — and it is now written to be TRUE rather than aspirational.
menuNote: No sidebar sub-menu by design — the 8 sections (Overview / Salary Manage / Staff Accounts / Salary Template / Loan Management / Payslip / Advance Salary / Reports) are pill-buttons at the top of the payroll desk.
note: Driven by the shared EPAL.payroll engine; posts accruals/payments/advances/loans/encashment to the GL tagged companyId:travels. ONE implementation serves every concern — EPAL.payrollDesk(page, cid) is mounted by Master Accounts and by each company's Accounts module, so the group desk and a company desk cannot diverge.
